sanskrit: jyotiṣmantaṃ sukṛtāṃ lokam īpsan pañcaudanaṃ brahmaṇe 'jaṃ dadāti | sa vyāpnuhy abhi lokaṃ jayāsmai śivo 'smabhyaṃ pratigṛhīta edhi ||
english: Desiring the luminous world of the well-doers, he gives the goat of fivefold rice-dish to the brahmin. Spread yourself, win that world for him; be gracious to us, and become the accepted offering.

sanskrit: ajas trināke tridive tripṛṣṭhe sukṛtāṃ loke dadivāṃsaṃ dadhāti | pañcaudano brahmaṇe dīyamānaḥ sa dātāraṃ tṛptyā tarpayāsi ||
english: The goat bears the giver to the triple firmament, to the triple heaven, to the triple back of the sky, to the world of the well-doers. The five-rice-dish goat, being given to the brahmin, satisfies the giver with satiety.

sanskrit: ajo hy agner ajaniṣṭa śokād vipro viprasya sahaso vayodhāḥ | hutam iṣṭam abhipūrtaṃ vaṣaṭkṛtaṃ tad devā ṛtuśaḥ kalpayantu ||
english: For the goat was born from the flame of Agni—the wise one, life-sustaining, born of the might of the wise. That which is offered, sacrificed, fulfilled, and consecrated with vaṣaṭ—may the gods arrange that in due season.

sanskrit: amotaṃ vāso dadhyād dhiraṇyam api dakṣiṇām | tathā lokān samāpnuyād ye divyā ye ca pārthivāḥ ||
english: He should place an unwoven garment and gold as the sacrificial fee; thus he shall attain fully all the worlds, both those celestial and those earthly.

sanskrit: etās tvāja dhārā upa yantu viśvataḥ somyā devīr ghṛtapṛṣṭhā madhuścutaḥ | stabhāna pṛthivīṃ divaṃ sacasva nāke tiṣṭhāsy adhi saptaraśmau ||
english: O goat, may these streams approach you from all sides—divine, belonging to Soma, their backs of ghee, dripping honey. Propping up the earth, accompany heaven; stand upon the vault of heaven, upon the seven-rayed one.

sanskrit: pṛṣṭhāt pṛthivyā iti catasraḥ ||
english: "From the back of the earth"—thus the four [verses are recited].

sanskrit: pañcaudanaṃ pañcabhir aṅgulībhir darvyod dhara pañcadhaudanam etam | prācīṃ diśaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ pratīcīm udīcīṃ dhruvām ūrdhvāṃ diśam ā kramasva ||
english: Lift this five-rice dish with five fingers from the ladle, this fivefold rice offering. Stride out toward the eastern quarter, the southern, the western, the northern, the fixed, and the upward direction.

sanskrit: prācyāṃ diśi śiro ajasya dhehi dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi dakṣiṇaṃ dhehi pārśvam | pratīcyāṃ diśi bhasadam asya udīcyāṃ diśy uttaraṃ dhehi pārśvam ||
english: Place the goat's head in the eastern quarter; place the right flank in the southern quarter. Place its hindquarters in the western quarter; place the left flank in the northern quarter.

sanskrit: ajasyānūkam ūrdhvāyāṃ diśi dhehi diśi dhehi pājasyaṃ dhruvāyām | antarikṣe madhyato madhyam asya padbhiś caturbhiḥ prati tiṣṭha dikṣu ||
english: Place the goat's spine in the upward direction; place the chest in the fixed direction. Place its middle in the midst of the atmosphere; stand firm in the quarters with its four feet.

sanskrit: śṛtam ajaṃ śṛtayā prorṇuhi tvacā sarvair aṅgaiḥ saṃbhṛtaṃ viśvarūpam | sa ut tiṣṭha prehi nākam uttamaṃ padbhiś caturbhiḥ prati tiṣṭha dikṣu ||
english: Cover the cooked goat with the cooked skin; it is assembled of all limbs, of universal form. Rise up, proceed to the highest vault of heaven; stand firm in the quarters with its four feet.

sanskrit: sarvā diśaḥ saṃvidānāḥ sadhrīcīḥ sāntardeśāḥ prati gṛhṇantu tejasam | te rakṣantu tava tubhyam etaṃ tābhyo juhomi haviṣā ghṛtena ||
english: May all the quarters, unanimous and confluent, together with the intermediate regions, accept the radiance. May they protect this offering of yours, for you; unto them I offer with oblation and with ghee.

sanskrit: yaṃ brāhmaṇe nidadhe yaṃ ca vikṣu yā vipruṣa odanānām ajasya | sarvaṃ tad agne sukṛtasya loke jānītān naḥ saṃgamane pathīnām ||
english: What was deposited for the brahmin, and what was deposited among the people, whatever drops of the goat's rice-dish—may all that, O Agni, be known in the world of the well-doer; may the paths lead to our coming together.

sanskrit: ajaḥ pañcaudano vy akramata | tasyora iyam abhavad udaram antarikṣaṃ dyauḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ diśaḥ pārśve ||
english: The five-rice-dish goat strode forth extensively. This earth became its lap, the atmosphere its belly, the sky its back, and the directions its flanks.

sanskrit: ditiś cāditiś ca śṛṅge satyaṃ ca rtaṃ ca cakṣuṣī | viśvaṃ rūpaṃ śraddhā prāṇo virāṭ śiraḥ ||
english: Diti and Aditi are its two horns; Truth and Order are its two eyes; the universal form is its body; Faith is its breath; Virāj is its head.

sanskrit: eṣa vā aparimito yajño yad ajaḥ pañcaudanaḥ | aparimitaṃ lokaṃ jayaty aparimitaṃ lokam ava rundhe ya evaṃ viduṣe 'jaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dadāti ||
english: This sacrifice is indeed boundless—namely, the five-rice-dish goat. He wins a boundless world, he obtains a boundless world, who gives the five-rice-dish goat to one who knows thus.

sanskrit: nāsyāsthīni bhindyān na majjño nir dhayet | sarvāṇi samādāya- -idaṃidaṃ pra veśayet ||
english: One should not break its bones, nor should one draw out the marrow. Having gathered all of them together, one should insert this and this [piece by piece back into the whole].

sanskrit: idam idam asya rūpaṃ tenainaṃ saṃ gamayati | svadhām ūrjam akṣitiṃ maho asmai duhe ya evaṃ viduṣe 'jaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dadāti ||
english: This and this is its form; by that one causes it to come together. It yields to him svadhā, vigor, inexhaustibility, and greatness—to one who gives the five-rice-dish goat to one who knows thus.

sanskrit: indrāya bhāgaṃ savitā kṛṇotv imaṃ yajñaṃ yajñapatiś ca sūriḥ | ye no dveṣanty anu tān rabhasva- -ariṣṭā vīrā yajamānasya sarve ||
english: May Savitṛ make the share for Indra; may the lord of sacrifice, the generous patron, prosper this sacrifice. Pursue those who hate us; may all the heroes of the sacrificer be unharmed.

sanskrit: pañca lokāḥ pañca rtavaḥ | pañcasv ṛtuṣv ṛdhnoti ya evaṃ viduṣe 'jaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dadāti ||
english: Five are the worlds, five are the seasons. He prospers in all five seasons who gives the five-rice-dish goat to one who knows thus.

sanskrit: eṣa vai nidāgho yajño yad ajaḥ pañcaudanaḥ | nir apriyaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ dahati bhavaty ātmanā parāsyāpriyo bhrātṛvyo bhavati (…) ||
english: This sacrifice is indeed the scorching fire—namely, the five-rice-dish goat. It burns away the hostile rival; by his own self he becomes one whose hostile rival has been driven off [from him].

sanskrit: yo vā āyantam ity ṛtuṃ veda | āyatīm evāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyam ādatte bhavaty ātmanā (…) (…) ||
english: Whoever knows the season as "the approaching one"—he takes away the approaching prosperity of the hostile rival; by his own self he becomes one [who has prevailed].

sanskrit: yo vai sarvam ity ṛtuṃ veda | sarvām evāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyam ādatte bhavaty ātmanā parāsyāpriyo bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ viduṣe 'jaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dadāti ||
english: Whoever knows the season as "the all"—he takes away all the prosperity of the hostile rival; by his own self he becomes one whose hostile rival has been driven off from him—he who gives the five-rice-dish goat to one who knows thus.

sanskrit: yāvanty asya lomāni brahmāstṛṇoti vedyām | tāvatīr asya dhārāḥ samudrasyevākṣitāḥ ||
english: As many as are the hairs of it that the brahmin strews upon the altar—so many are the inexhaustible streams that flow for him, as from the ocean.

sanskrit: duhāṃ kṣīraṃ bhavatu sarpir ebhyaḥ surā bhūtvopa tiṣṭhāt surāpām | madhor dhārā madhupebhyo duhāno 'jo nāke tiṣṭhatu modamānaḥ ||
english: May it yield milk; may there be ghee for these; having become spirituous liquor, may it attend upon the drinkers of surā. Yielding streams of mead for the drinkers of mead, may the goat stand rejoicing upon the vault of heaven.
